description: This file defines classes, interfaces, and functions related to storing and managing device authentication tokens within an Android application. It includes data classes for auth entries and metadata, an interface for token storage operations, and a concrete implementation that interacts with secure preferences.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: Data class representing a device authentication token, role, associated scopes, and last updated timestamp.

classes.name: PersistedDeviceAuthMetadata
classes.description: Serializable data class used to persist additional metadata about device authentication, including scopes and last update time.

classes.name: DeviceAuthTokenStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for loading, saving, and clearing device authentication tokens.

classes.name: DeviceAuthStore
classes.description: Implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore that interacts with SecurePrefs to persist tokens and metadata.

methods.name: loadEntry
methods.description: Loads a DeviceAuthEntry for the specified device ID and role from preferences.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Saves a token along with scope information for a specific device ID and role.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes a token and its metadata for a specific device ID and role.

methods.name: tokenKey
methods.description: Constructs a key for storing/retrieving the device token in preferences.

methods.name: metadataKey
methods.description: Constructs a key for storing/retrieving metadata about the device token.

methods.name: normalizeDeviceId
methods.description: Normalizes device ID strings by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Normalizes role strings by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Normalizes a list of scope strings by trimming, filtering out empty entries, removing duplicates, and sorting.
